findings.quote: Kal school la hoto, pan fire raatri la lagla.
findings.canon: day 1 Fri 02 Jan 14:10 — Madhura Chavan was present: "A fire broke out at Ratanben Chunilal Mehta (RCM) Gujarati High School"
findings.why: The fire broke out at 14:10 (2:10 PM), not at night (raatri) as stated by Madhura, who was present and should know the correct time.

findings.quote: Dnyaneshwar and Aditya drag their feet over breakfast, still uneasy after yesterday's fire rumour.
findings.canon: day 1 Fri 02 Jan 14:10 — Madhura, Dnyaneshwar, Vaishali, Aditya were all present: 'A fire broke out at Ratanben Chunilal Mehta (RCM) Gujarati High School'
findings.why: The scene treats the fire as an unconfirmed rumour from yesterday, but all four family members personally witnessed the actual fire on day 1.

notes: The family's overall coherence is strong except for Madhura misstating the time of the fire in the day 3 scene, a direct contradiction of the canon event time.
The family's shared memory of the school fire is lost; they discuss it as hearsay days after it happened, undermining a key canon event.
